validity.recommendation: Existence and route are solidly confirmed by two independent Krasnoyarsk outlets, but they disagree on length: verify 1600 km vs 670 km before treating either as settled.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, well-documented project -- confirmed by two independent Krasnoyarsk media outlets (tvk6.ru Mar 2020, kislorod.life 2020) that both name the exact route 'Проскоково – Ачинск – Красноярск – Канск – Балаганск' verbatim and describe it as the 'most realistic' option in the official 2016 general gas-supply/gasification scheme for Krasnoyarsk Krai, never built, superseded in practice by Power of Siberia-2 planning. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission gas trunk. SPEC CONCERN: the two sources disagree materially on length -- tvk6.ru states 1,600 km (matches the sheet's recorded 1600.00 exactly) while kislorod.life states 670 km for the SAME named route. This is not a rounding difference; one of the two is wrong, or they are describing different route variants (e.g. total corridor to Balagansk vs. a shorter segment to Krasnoyarsk only) that neither article disambiguates. Recommend a researcher revisit with the actual 2016 general gasification scheme document (Схема газоснабжения и газификации Красноярского края) to resolve which figure is the engineered length. STATUS: 'cancelled' is defensible but not literally documented -- no source states a formal cancellation act; both sources describe indefinite freezing/non-viability rather than a cancellation decision. Checked for a REVIVAL under Power of Siberia-2 or the Oct 2024 Krasnoyarsk gasification roadmap (Kotyukov/Miller) -- none found; as of Oct 2024 coverage, Krasnoyarsk is pursuing autonomous LNG/propane-butane gasification instead of a trunk pipeline, so this route remains dormant, not revived.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Confirmed still not built / no revival under this exact routing. Newest evidence checked: Oct 2024 Krasnoyarsk gasification coverage (tvknews.ru news/85075, news/85225; newslab.ru 2020-11-25) shows Krasnoyarsk Krai's Oct 2024 gasification roadmap (Kotyukov-Miller) relies on autonomous LNG/propane-butane gasification because 'no pipeline infrastructure exists' -- i.e. this trunk route (or any trunk route from Proskokovo) is still not chosen/built as of late 2024. Power of Siberia-2 is the only active pipeline planning near these same cities (Achinsk/Krasnoyarsk/Kansk) but per Kommersant 2022-09-01 that is a distinct east-west export corridor, not a revival of this west-in gasification branch. No evidence of formal cancellation OR of an active build -- 'cancelled'/dormant stands.

summary: confirmed (caveat): real, well-documented 1600km Proskokovo-Achinsk-Krasnoyarsk-Kansk-Balagansk scheme frozen since 2019-2020, all 6 units sourced; spec concern on Length (2nd source says 670km, not 1600); status confirmed still dormant as of Oct 2024.
